_comment: Gameplay tunable variables and server-side limit overrides.
build_dock_slots_comment: Number of ships under simultaneous construction.
max_gear_skin_boxes_comment: Maximum number of gear skin boxes in the shop.
tutorial_first_build_ship_comment: Ship template id granted as EVERY commander's first (tutorial) build; 0 or absent = normal random roll. 202121=Belfast.
exercise_bot_level_percent_comment: NPC rival ship level range in Exercises as percent offset from player top-6 average (default -10 and 10 for +/-10%).
exercise_recover_amount_comment: Number of exercise attempts recovered each recovery period (00:00, 12:00, 18:00).
exercise_refreshes_per_day_comment: Number of free rival list refreshes ('New Opponents') allowed per day.
exercise_rival_fallback_level_comment: Base ship level for NPC rivals if the player owns no ships.
commission_crit_chance_percent_comment: Chance (0-100%) of Great Success / getting 'May Find' drops from commissions.
urgent_commission_spawn_chance_percent_c: Chance (0-100%) of spawning an urgent commission after chapter victory.
sub_strike_damage_cap_percent_comment: Min and max HP damage reduction percentage from chapter submarine strikes.
build_time_multiplier_comment: Multiplier for ship construction time (1.0 = normal, 0.0 = instant).
default_build_time_seconds_comment: Fallback construction time in seconds if not found in build_times.json.
shopstreet_goods_count_comment: Number of items offered in Shiranui's shopping street.
